title: Share Link
description: Prevents oversharing through links by reading every setting back as one sentence ("Anyone with the link can edit until Fri 16 Oct, 5:00 PM"), warning on public edit access and open-ended public links with one-tap fixes, showing a live expiry countdown, flagging when you widen a link you've already copied, and confirming before revoking.
stops: Anyone with the link could edit
